title: Open Sesame
logline: A poor woodcutter hiding in a tree sees forty thieves open a rock with two words, takes only a little of their treasure, and loses the secret to his greedy brother.
moral: Contentment keeps a man safe; greed stops listening. (The film ends on the open question, not on a stated moral.)
tone: 80s cel adventure: quiet painted worlds, a small flat hero, suspense by stillness, two bright impact frames, a gold-lit peak still, a wry cliffhanger.

beats.summary: Ali Baba, a poor woodcutter with a family and a donkey in a small town.
He hears horses coming fast; the donkey hears them first.
Fearing thieves, he climbs a tall tree and hides until only his eyes show.
Forty men with heavy sacks reach a great rock.
The rock splits and a secret door appears.
Much later they come out, mount and close the rock with Close Sesame.
Ali Baba climbs down carefully and approaches the rock.
He repeats the words and the door opens before his eyes.
Amazed, yet he takes only one small sack.
He tells his wife and asks her to tell no one.
Cassim notices the new coins and presses until he knows the secret.
Cassim can think only of gold and barely listens to the words.
He sets off with cart and empty sacks: would he remember how to get out?

sets.description: Ali Baba's cottage yard at dawn: villageYard with sky:false over the painted plate 'dawnTown' (tall peach to cobalt sky, far town roofs with three lit windows). Cottage default position, axe peg by the door, a missing roof tile. Ground y 900.

Looping painted morning forest for side tracking: 4 layers, each 2000 wide and tileable. Far: pale blue-green trunks in mist (parallax 0.25). Mid: violet-blue trunks 60..90 wide with mint canopy (0.5). Path layer: ochre earth path at y 900 with fern clumps (1.0). Front: dark trunks and ferns (1.6, 16 px horizontal smear). Slanting gold light shafts 120 wide at 25 degrees as an additive layer. Also the locked chopping view: fallen trunk 200 x 60 at x 560..760.

The main strip, 2400 x 1230, ground y 900, painted in three colour models (afternoon amber, dusk violet-rose with a low orange sun at the left, late dusk). Thicket at x 220 (300 x 190, with a front pass). Tall hide tree at x 520: trunk 90 wide from y 900 to y 330, perch branch at y 400 to x 700, foliage mass centre (540, 300) radius 260 with a front pass and an eye gap 120 x 46 at (600, 372). Path along y 900. Horse line x 1150..1480. sesameRock at x 1500..2150, top y 250. A dark leaf frame overlay (top left corner, 380 x 300) is used in wides of the rock as Ali Baba's point of view.

Cave interior plate 1600 x 1230, floor y 900: door opening at the left x 60..280 with steps and dusk violet outside; rough arched ceiling with 9 stalactites (front layer); back wall glow painted as a soft gold radial; gold zone x 420..760 (coin mounds up to 260 high, open chest 200 x 150, vases), silver zone x 800..1080 (ewers, plates, pale coin heaps, cool glow), cloth zone x 1120..1480 (12 bales stacked 3 high, 5 bolts hanging from a rope at y 420). Row of sacks at x 420..520 in three sizes.

hutRoom with palette 'night', lamp 1 on a stool at x 505, mat, door on the left, window upper right showing the moonlit sky (Cassim's head appears in it through the window callback). Night colour model: indigo walls, warm lamp circle, gold coin light from the mat.

countryRoad (w 3000, sky:false) over the painted plate 'preDawn' (indigo to pale teal sky, last stars, a thin peach band on the horizon), with the house lit at the left and sesameRock drawn at scale 0.22 on the horizon at strip x 2500, base y 880.

props.description: The great rock with its hidden door: see new_assets.

Planned sack with fill 0..1 and a coin mark: full and heavy on the thieves' saddles and shoulders, flat when they leave, three sizes in the cave (Ali Baba's is s 0.5), a flapping heap of empty ones on Cassim's cart.

subtitles.ar: عاش علي بابا مع أسرته في بلدة صغيرة، وكان حطابًا فقيرًا.|كل صباح أخذ حماره إلى الغابة|وجمع الحطب ليبيعه في السوق.
subtitles.en: Ali Baba lived with his family in a small town and worked as a poor woodcutter.|Each morning he took his donkey to the forest|and gathered wood to sell at market.

subtitles.ar: في أحد الأيام سمع أصوات خيول تقترب بسرعة.|خاف أن يكون الفرسان لصوصًا، فصعد إلى شجرة عالية|واختبأ بين أوراقها، ثم راقب الطريق من مكانه.
subtitles.en: One day he heard horses approaching quickly.|Afraid that the riders were thieves, he climbed a tall tree,|hid among its leaves, and watched the path below.

subtitles.ar: وصل أربعون رجلًا بأكياس ثقيلة إلى صخرة كبيرة.|نادى قائدهم: «افتح يا سمسم!»|فانشقت الصخرة وظهر باب سري.
subtitles.en: Forty men carrying heavy sacks reached a large rock.|Their leader called, “Open Sesame!”|The rock split open, revealing a secret door.

subtitles.ar: دخل الرجال الكهف بأكياسهم، ثم أغلق الباب من خلفهم.|وبعد وقت طويل خرجوا وركبوا خيولهم.|صاح القائد: «أغلق يا سمسم!» فعادت الصخرة كما كانت.
subtitles.en: The men entered the cave carrying their sacks, and the door closed behind them.|Much later they came out and mounted their horses.|The leader called, “Close Sesame!” and the rock returned to normal.

subtitles.ar: انتظر علي بابا حتى اختفت الخيول، ثم نزل من الشجرة بحذر.|اقترب من الصخرة، وردد الكلمات التي سمعها: «افتح يا سمسم!»|فانفتح الباب أمام عينيه.
subtitles.en: Ali Baba waited until the horses disappeared, then carefully descended the tree.|He approached the rock and repeated the words he had heard: “Open Sesame!”|The door opened before his eyes.

subtitles.ar: وجد في الكهف ذهبًا وفضة وأقمشة ثمينة.|دهش من الكنوز، لكنه أخذ كيسًا صغيرًا من النقود،|وأغلق الباب وعاد مسرعًا.
subtitles.en: Inside, he found gold, silver, and costly cloth.|Though amazed by the treasure, he took only a small sack of coins,|closed the door, and hurried home.

subtitles.ar: أخبر علي بابا زوجته بما رأى، وطلب منها ألا تحدث أحدًا.|لكن أخاه قاسم لاحظ النقود الجديدة،|وظل يسأل عنها حتى عرف سر الكهف العجيب.
subtitles.en: Ali Baba told his wife what he had seen and asked her not to tell anyone.|But his brother Cassim noticed the new coins|and kept asking questions until he discovered the cave’s secret.

subtitles.ar: لم يفكر قاسم إلا في الذهب.|أخذ من علي بابا مكان الصخرة والكلمات، ثم انطلق بعربته وأكياسه الفارغة.|هل سيتذكر كيف يخرج؟
subtitles.en: Cassim could think only of gold.|He learned the rock’s location and the magic words from Ali Baba, then set off with his cart and empty sacks.|Would he remember how to get out?

new_assets.name: sesameRock
new_assets.description: Great rock 650 wide x 650 high (x 1500..2150, top y 250, base y 900) with a vertical seam at x 1820 and an arched door 220 x 330 (x 1710..1930, top y 570) hidden behind the two halves. Fields: open 0..1 (each half slides 115 units outward), crack 0..1 (a gold line of light climbing the seam from the base), glow 0..1 (door light and the wedge on the ground), model ('afternoon' | 'dusk' | 'late' | 'silhouette'), s (scale, used at 0.22 on the horizon). Reusable for any magic door, sealed cave or treasure rock.
new_assets.implementation: Outline from about 14 points with 3 facet planes; draw each half with celShade(ctx, pts, fill, shade, {light, hi}) clipped to its side of the seam and translated by open * 115. Behind the halves: door arch (townArchPts pointed) filled with a gold radial gradient plus 3 steps; over it an additive halation disc scaled by glow. Ground wedge: a 4 point polygon from the door foot fanning left 500 units, alpha 0.5 * glow. Grit: dustBurst at the seam top and base while open changes. Moss patches and a few cracks are painted in the plate pass (soft), facets are cel (hard).

new_assets.name: treasureCave
new_assets.description: The gold-lit cave interior described under sets (1600 x 1230), a painted plate with an emissive pair and cel treasure on top. Reusable for any treasure vault or den with a palette option.
new_assets.implementation: bake() the plate: dark umber to plum vertical gradient, soft gold radial glows behind each zone (ctx radialGradient, alpha 0.5), rock wall strokes blurred 2 px at bake time (ctx.filter blur), stalactites as celShade triangles on a separate front layer. Treasure as cels: coinPile mounds (ellipse stacks with hard highlight crescents), chest (rounded box, lid open 0.8), ewers and plates (silver palette), clothBale x12, hanging bolts as ribbons (4 drawing sine cycle). Glints: 4 point stars popped on celStep(t,12) with seeded offsets. goldGlow (planned) for the halation: additive radial + star glints, strength 0..1.

new_assets.name: celPlates
new_assets.description: The painted background layer and its light tools for this style: paintPlate(key, w, h, draw, model) and the plates dawnTown, forestMorning (4 tileable layers), rockAfternoon / rockDusk / rockLate (the rockGlade strip in three colour models, including the tall hide tree and thicket with front passes), nightTown, preDawn; lightBands(ctx, rect, t, {col, angle, w, speed}) sweeping coloured bands over a held cel with source-atop; speedLines(ctx, rect, t, {dir, n, seed}); the colour model table MODEL = {morning, afternoon, dusk, cave, night, predawn} with lit / shade / line multipliers and a skin colour per set.
new_assets.implementation: paintPlate bakes once: sky by linear gradient (2 to 4 stops per model), airbrushed clouds as blurred ellipses with a lighter underside, land shapes filled flat then softened with ctx.filter = 'blur(1.5px)' and glazed with 2 or 3 large radial gradients (sun side warm, far side cool); Library sets (villageYard, countryRoad, hutRoom) are baked through the same glaze so they sit in the painted world. Cels are never glazed. Cast colour models: draw the character through the castFinish offscreen pattern, multiply by MODEL.lit with source-atop at the listed strength, then redraw Ali Baba's sash and turban band in the pure accent and keep the face skin from the model table (do not let the tint turn faces pink or grey). lightBands and speedLines are drawn on ones.

new_assets.name: handcart
new_assets.description: Two-wheeled cart (planned name, KD-011): bed 260 x 60 with slatted sides 50 high, bed floor 95 above the ground, two spoked wheels r 62 (8 spokes), two shafts 190 long to the animal's collar, option load (a heap of flat sacks drawn as 6 overlapping ribbons). Fields: x, y, wheel (angle from distance / 62), tilt, bounce.
new_assets.implementation: celShade rectangles for the bed and slats, wheels as circle + spokes rotated by wheel; shafts as two lines to the donkey's shoulder point (mountSeat or measured). Cassim stands in it as person clipped at the slat top. Empty sacks: sack {fill:0} shapes with a travelling sine on their free ends.

new_assets.name: treeClimb and leafHide
new_assets.description: A person climbing a trunk (4 key poses cycled on twos, hands and feet on trunk points, body sway, reversed for the descent) and hiding in foliage so that only the eyes show in a dark gap.
new_assets.implementation: Use handLW/handRW world targets on alternating trunk points 70 apart; legs from the walk phase with a short stride, drawn with the figure offset 30 to the side of the trunk and tip 0.12 toward it; y from flow() keys sampled at celStep(t,12). leafHide: draw the person, then the foliage front pass with an evenodd hole (rounded rect 120 x 46) so only the eye band shows; for the close view draw two eyes (the style's eye primitive via person clipped at zoom 2.4) inside the gap.

owner_questions: The film ends on a question, so a TO BE CONTINUED card would suit the anime medium; default used: the standard THE END card (139.0 to 142.94).

The magic words are shown on screen as Arabic display lettering in Lalezar (افتح يا سمسم at 42.76 and 82.84, أغلق يا سمسم at 64.06), copied from the script; default: shown, with no English version beside them (the English subtitle carries it).
Added staging not in the script: Ali Baba hides the donkey in a thicket and later rides it home; his wife and one child wave him off in the opening (the family); default: kept.

Added staging: Cassim first appears spying through the window and ends by not listening to the words (they drift past his ear and fall off the cart), which hints at the answer to the last question; default: kept as a visual hint only.
Cassim's cart is drawn by a brown donkey rather than pushed by hand; default: donkey cart.
The forty thieves are 1 leader, 6 drawn riders and 33 silhouettes with a counter running to 40; default: this mix rather than forty drawn figures.
The script does not say Ali Baba speaks to close the door at 101.30; default: he mimes the leader's gesture with moving lips and no lettering.
implementation_notes: Style: cel-anime-80s. Frame with S.background(ctx, W, H, t, THEME.page) and S.box(ctx, 54, 54, 972, 1196, 1, THEME.panel); S.finish last (the CRT pass). Use palette names and BF, never fixed Halftone colours.

Twos: every character pose channel is evaluated at tc = celStep(t, THEME.celFps) (12 fps); blinks, lip flaps and eye openings at celStep(t, 8). Camera, plates, lightBands, speedLines, glows, dust and the CRT run on ones (t). Never step the camera.
Four layers per shot in this order: painted plate (baked, soft), cels (cast and props, flat with celShade hard shade and coloured lines), light (goldGlow, lightBands, castFinish rim), then S.finish.

Colour models: morning (S1-S2), afternoon amber (S3-S7), dusk violet-rose (S8-S11, S13 outside), cave gold (S12-S13), night indigo with lamp (S14-S16), pre-dawn teal (S17). Each is a plate repaint plus a cel multiplier from MODEL, not a filter over the frame. Ali Baba's vermilion sash and turban band are redrawn in the pure accent in every model.

Cues: use w(p, n) from timing.json; the cue times in this plan are the word starts in timeline.md. Impact frames at 44.86, 85.02 and 137.93 are silent (they fall inside speech); sound goes only in the listed pauses.

Groups: riders use stagger(i) and a seed each (bob phase, lean, cloak phase, beard, face cloth colour); horses in the line get separate tailSwish and ear seeds. Never two mounts or two flinches on the same frame.
